changes.comment: Refactor the external provider loader into a kind-agnostic package-loader skeleton (registry/provider-loader.ts) plus per-kind contract assertions for agentRuntime and channel, and add a channel provider loader that resolves builtin:feishu -> @excitedjs/feishu-channel through the shared built-in package alias map (issue #209). The public loadExternalAgentRuntimeProviders surface and its error classes are unchanged; no behavior change.
